# Strobe Cut

**Cut › Smash Cut** · v1.0.0 · 18 frames at 30 fps (8–40)

Cuts back and forth between the two scenes faster and faster, then lands on the new one.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/strobe-cut@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Music videos and beat drops
- Hype edits
- Glitchy energy without effects

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import strobeCut from './transitions/01-cut/smash-cut/strobe-cut';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(strobeCut, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 18 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `flips` | integer | `6` | 2–16 | How many times the picture swaps. |
